D1.text:
D1 ACTIONS initiates a request.
D2 PRINCIPLES governs the process.
D3 MATHS defines the structural relationships.
D4 ADDRESS provides an address and a score.
The request is refused if the tier is not reached.
A D1 telling exceeds its source by 1.44 times.
The guard discards the excessive telling.

entailment.why: D1 initiates a request (source states tiers are assigned by trust graph position, not request).

D2.text: The governing rule dictates a structure of abstraction, progressing from raw data to a governing rule, then to mathematical relationships, and finally to an address with a score.

entailment.why: The telling asserts progression, while the source states tier assignment is not by request.

D3.text: Five tiers exist. A one-way map connects them. D0 crosses to nobody. D1 reduces entities to roles. D2 defines a rule. D3 contains relations, types, and quantities. D4 is an address and a score. Refusal occurs for unreached tiers. A longer telling is discarded.

entailment.why: Longer tellings are discarded (source says longer tellings were initially present, then discarded).
